rule: For every delivered specification of a solve or clarify brief, each numeric value that places a support, load or passive region (centres, sizes, spans, radii, box corners) and each load force component is tagged 'traceable' when it can be formed from the numbers written in the brief: a brief number (also x1000 and /1000 for unit changes), zero, a domain size, half of either, or a sum or difference of two of these (each optionally halved). Anything else is tagged 'untraced', i.e. assumed by the agent. A specification is flagged when it carries any untraced value. The rule was fixed before the wrong/right split was examined; it is a post hoc proxy for typed field provenance, not part of the evaluated system. As a control it is applied to the reference readings too. No LLM calls, no solves.
